modelingNotes: Exact Siemens order-number candidate. The SM1231 family name alone does not establish this order number, channel configuration or generation.

All 14 X10/X11 connector positions are inventoried:11 assigned,3 manufacturer no-connection positions. Both connectors require gold contacts. L+/M supply terminals are required even though the reference diagram omits them.
Differential channels preserve both terminals as distinct electrical endpoints. No internal physical net joins or automatic shorting are inferred.

TC alloy, range, filtering and cold-junction configuration are project choices. The cited manual discusses unused-input shorting and channel deactivation; apply the documented selected mode explicitly rather than inventing catalog jumpers.

Backplane bus, module electronics, diagnostic behavior and complete installation requirements are not modeled. No-connection positions are inventory annotations; this version does not enforce a do-not-wire policy.

The original continuous thermite:io-module profile does not render two-terminal analog channel functions. Use signal-loop or terminal-wiring views for these channels and retain unsupported-view diagnostics.

connectionCoverage.notes: All external field connector positions are inventoried; internal backplane bus and configuration-dependent diagnostics are not modeled.
